summary: Describes extending the IETF Datatracker to record and show how Internet-Drafts progress when they are intended for RFC publication by the IAB, IRTF, or Independent Submissions streams. States and annotations apply once a stream marks a draft as a potential RFC.

eli5.summary: A tracking website follows each document from draft to published RFC. This explains the new steps and notes it needs for documents from three streams outside the main IETF process.

questions: datatracker iab irtf independent stream states
how are non-ietf stream drafts tracked
